text:
maya: Quick heads-up — I just pushed a change to the metering ingest contract. token_count is being deprecated in favor of token_units (float) to support fractional attribution from batching. This will affect tallying and invoice-preview math.

 dave: fractional units? can you explain the problem we're solving? :thinking_face:

maya: long story short: when a single logical request is split across backend shards for concurrency, we were rounding at the shard boundary which caused +-1 token skews that show up as invoice preview noise. token_units lets us preserve fractional shares and sum consistently.

olivia: can you paste the proto?

maya: ```proto
message MeterEvent {
  string tenant_id = 1;
  string route = 2;
  // old field, will be removed after 30 days
  int64 token_count = 3;
  // new, normalized units (could be fractional)
  double token_units = 4;
  int64 timestamp_ms = 5;
}
```

liam: will existing consumers (tally, preview, billing ETL) be broken if they ignore token_units?

maya: No — ingest writes both fields for now. Ingest sets token_count = floor(token_units) for backwards compat; consumers should read token_units ASAP. We'll run a 30-day compatibility window.

nina: how does this affect quota enforcement? Quota checks run on integer tokens in the edge proxy today.

maya: Good call. Plan: edge proxy continues integer checks (token_count) for enforcement. Billing/tally/preview will use token_units. We need to align dashboards and alerts to avoid false positives on quota burn rates.

dave: ok but invoices are computed from aggregated ledgers. If we change the unit semantics, historical comparisons will show a small delta. How do we show customers the delta in preview?

maya: We added a migration tool in the preview service that recomputes the last 24h using token_units and exposes a "delta_preview" field in the invoice preview UI. UX: show a single-line note: "Preview uses post-migration units — expects ~0.3% difference".

olivia: will the delta be visible in all dashboards? We should emit a telemetry tag on rollup jobs: `units_migration=v1->v2` and a per-tenant delta metric.

maya: Yep, emit `billing.preview.delta_pct` and `billing.tally.delta_pct` with tags {tenant, route, canary_bucket}. We'll wire those into console graphs.

sre-bot: Alert: canary bucket 3 billing.preview.delta_pct exceeding threshold (0.9%) — triggered at 1748612367

liam: whoops. That's higher than expected. What traffic did we send to canary bucket 3?

maya: Canary traffic was ~1% of requests routed to the new ingest path. We saw a spike on long-chat prompt sets causing slightly different tokenization rounding behavior in an older tokenizer version we didn't pin.

dave: do we rollback or patch?

maya: short term: pause canary (flip feature flag) and revert the tokenizer bump in the canary path. Long term: pin tokenizer in ingest image and add an invariant test: recompute tokens(old) vs token_units and assert delta < 0.5% on core promptset.

nina: for console UX: when canary is paused, invoice-preview should display an inline note that previewing post-migration numbers is temporarily unavailable for some tenants. Otherwise customers will see inconsistent deltas.

maya: Agreed. I'll open a small PR to add the UI banner and turn on a warning metric.

olivia: also need a migration runbook: steps to enable canary -> monitor `billing.preview.delta_pct` and `tally.delta_pct` -> if > 1% for 10m rollback. Add runbook to the deployment page.

maya: created ENG-4521 for migration runbook and ENG-4522 to pin tokenizer and add unit tests.

dave: ENG-4521 sounds good. Who's owning monitoring dashboards?

liam: ops can own the canary dashboard; I'll add a small panel that shows `billing.preview.delta_pct` across buckets and a heatmap by route.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: ingest-schema-v2 -> canary 1% at 1748612388 (maya)

maya: I'll hold the rollout until the tokenizer pin is in. Will reschedule deploy-bot.

dave: thanks. one more ask: please post a short note in #product about potential invoice-preview differences so CS doesn't get surprised tomorrow.

maya: will do — pinging @product-leads with a short summary and the expected timeline. :thumbsup:

nina: and let's add a regression alert for invoice-preview vs ledger finalization: if monthly invoice delta > 0.5% for any tenant after migration, auto-open a high-priority ticket.

maya: agreed, added to ENG-4521.

liam: TL;DR: hold on rollout, pin tokenizer, add unit tests, wire telemetry, add dashboard and runbook, 30-day dual-write compat window, then cutover.

maya: Exactly. Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the PRs and the #product note.
